messages.author: e5d0b3c2486cd4e3
messages.subject: Legend above title in 0.9.0
parts:
Hi, ggploteRs,

I just upgraded to 0.9.0 and noticed a change I cannot fix. If I place a horizontal legend above the plot (legend.position = "top") it's placed above the title instead of below. Anyway to reverse the order? I.e. legend below the title. Here's some code. Attachments show the difference between 0.8.9 and 0.9.0.

library(ggplot2)
sessionInfo()
ggplot.ver <- packageVersion("ggplot2")

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg))
p <- p + geom_point(aes(colour = qsec))
p <- p + opts(title = ggplot.ver,
              legend.position = "top",
              legend.direction = "horizontal")

filename <- paste("legend_", ggplot.ver, ".png", sep = "")
png(filename)
print(p)
dev.off()
